title: equal-channel receiver selection rank consistency
purpose: whether frozen R2 preserves physical ranking of left vs right reception for material discrimination
scope: source0, known center support, discrete material hypothesis discrimination; no blind reconstruction or acquisition savings

noise.model: iid Gaussian additive on full record generated once per target and seed
noise.std: 0.01 * RMS of saved full homogeneous trace; same scalar for all channels

score: sum of squared difference between hypothesis traces on incremental channels; independent equal variance Gaussian noise assumption; same 11 channels per action; tie chooses left
policy_note: two hypotheses fixed independent of pilot: static design, NOT adaptive policy; pilot is reserved for later extension, not used to claim adaptation
nominal: center .5 trace plus original .3/.7 secant times (a-.5); calibration costs separately reported
selection: freeze selected action before reading target observations; select material hypothesis with minimal unweighted SSE on pilot+chosen channels
evaluation: paired method error differences over common noise seeds
R2 vs physical action score ranking
interpretation: targets outside or between hypotheses test bounded discrimination; no claim exact material recovery; action disagreement prevents moving to active loop; agreement only qualifies this two-state observation design
verification: save predicted hypothesis traces and noisy observations; rederive scores and choices from raw data; hash all consumed PT and source files before run; no posthoc thresholds
cost: existing calibration files reused with historical cost unknown; cached offline channel masks do not equal hardware acquisition savings
stop: if shape, source coordinate, background or hashes mismatch save failure and stop; no extra runs to chase success
